transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Alex. I'm calling because I need to get some sort of mobile internet device. A hotspot, I think it's called? For some upcoming travel.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, you've called the right place. We can definitely help you with a mobile hotspot. To get started and access your account, I'll just need to verify your identity. Could you please provide me with your full name?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure, it's Jennifer Wright.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Jennifer. And could you provide the customer ID number found on your bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, let me see... I have it here. It's CUST-1005.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And for the final verification step, can you please provide the 4-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's three-five-six-five.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. 3-5-6-5. Let me just check that... and... great! Verification is successful. Thank you for your patience with that, Ms. Wright. I see you're already a valued Cymbal Telecom mobile customer.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I've had my cell phone with you for years.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We appreciate your loyalty. Now, about that hotspot. You mentioned some travel. To help me find the best plan for you, could you tell me a bit more? Will you be traveling domestically, and what kind of data usage are you expecting?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: It's all domestic, within the US. My husband and I bought an RV and we're planning a few long trips over the next year. I'll need it for my laptop for some remote work, and maybe streaming a movie on a tablet in the evenings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That sounds like a wonderful adventure! And a perfect use case for one of our hotspot devices. So you'll need enough data for work and some entertainment. I can certainly help with that.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. So what are my options?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have several data-only plans designed specifically for devices like this. They are separate from your mobile phone plan and come with their own data buckets. Are you looking for a specific amount of data per month?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I was looking online and I think something around 50 gigabytes seems like a good starting point. I don't want to run out, but I also don't want to pay for a huge amount I won't use.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fifty gigabytes is a very popular choice. It offers a great balance. Let me pull up the specifics for that plan for you. One moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, I have it here. Our 50 gigabyte data-only plan is $40 per month, plus applicable taxes and fees.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Forty dollars. Okay. And that's for high-speed data, right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's correct. You get 50 gigabytes of premium high-speed 5G and 4G LTE data, depending on the coverage in your area. Our network is quite extensive, especially along major travel routes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What happens if I go over the 50 gigabytes in a month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's a great question. With Cymbal Telecom, we don't have overage charges, so you'll never see a surprise on your bill. After you use the 50 gigabytes, your speeds are reduced for the remainder of the billing cycle. You'll still have unlimited data, just at a slower speed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: How much slower?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The speeds are reduced to about 1.5 megabits per second. It's still usable for checking emails and basic web browsing, but it would be difficult to stream high-definition video at that speed.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that makes sense. Good to know there are no extra fees. Does the data roll over to the next month if I don't use it all?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The data on these plans does not roll over. It resets at the start of each billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Alright, fair enough. And is there a contract? I might not need it every single month of the year.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No annual contract at all. It's a month-to-month service. You can suspend or cancel the line anytime you need to. You'd just be responsible for the cost of the device itself.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, right. The device. What are the options for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our premier hotspot is the Cymbal Go 5G Hotspot. It's a fantastic little device. It can connect up to 15 of your gadgets at once, has a battery that lasts all day, and a simple color touchscreen to manage your connection and see your data usage.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds like exactly what I need. How much does the Cymbal Go device cost?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The full retail price for the device is $240.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Ooh, okay. That's a bit of an investment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It is, but it's a very capable piece of hardware. We do have an option to make it more manageable. Since you're activating a new line, you qualify for our device payment plan. You can finance the device over 24 months.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how much would that be per month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It would be just $10 per month for 24 months, with zero percent interest. It would just be added to your monthly Cymbal bill alongside the $40 service plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: So, $50 a month total, plus taxes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. For 24 months, and then the device payment would fall off your bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hmm. Let me think. I don't love the idea of another monthly payment. I think I'd rather just buy it outright and be done with it. Can I do that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Of course. You can absolutely purchase the device for the full retail price of $240 today. Many customers prefer that simplicity.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, let's do that. So it's the $240 for the device, and $40 a month for the service. Is there any other fee I should know about? Like an activation fee?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, there is a one-time activation fee of $35 for any new line of service. That would be part of your initial costs.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay. So $240 plus $35.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. Your upfront cost for the hardware and activation would be $275, plus local sales tax on the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: And how does that get charged? On my next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We can do it a couple of ways. We can add the entire amount to your next monthly bill, or you can pay the hardware portion today with a credit or debit card, and then the first month of service and activation fee will appear on your next bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I think I'd prefer to pay for the hardware today and get it over with. Can I use the card I have on file for my monthly payments?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check what we have on file for you... I see a Visa card ending in 4-3-2-1. Is that the one you'd like to use for the $240 device purchase plus tax?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, wait... that's my old card. It expired. I must have updated it on the website. The new one should be a Mastercard.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Ah, okay. Thank you for clarifying. I am not able to see the full card number for your security, but I can see the payment method was updated recently. I can't charge to it directly without you providing the number again over the phone, which I'm happy to do in our secure system. Or, we can simply add the charge to your next bill, which will then be paid by that updated card automatically when it's due.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You know what, that's easier. Let's just put it all on the next bill. The device, the activation, the first month of service. All of it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sounds like a plan. That keeps everything simple and in one place. So, just to recap the order before I submit it for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, please.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We are adding one new Cymbal Telecom data line to your account. The plan is our 50 Gigabyte high-speed data plan for $40 per month. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, $40 for 50 gigs. Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. And we are shipping you one new Cymbal Go 5G Hotspot. You are purchasing this device at the full retail price of $240.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And finally, we are applying the standard one-time new line activation fee of $35.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So, your next bill will be higher than usual. It will include your regular mobile plan, plus the $240 for the device, the $35 activation fee, and the first month's $40 service charge for the hotspot, plus taxes. Does that all sound correct to you?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, it's a lot of numbers, but you've explained it clearly. That all sounds correct. Let's do it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. I just need your verbal confirmation to proceed with placing this order and adding these charges to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I agree. Please proceed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I am submitting the order now. Please give me about 60 to 90 seconds while the system processes everything.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for your patience, Jennifer. I have great news. The order is confirmed!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have an order confirmation number for you. Do you have a pen and paper handy?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, I do. Go ahead.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your order number is D-T-C-8-8-1-5-9-0-2.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You'll also receive an email confirmation with all these details at the email address we have on file, jennifer.wright@telecom-personal.com. Is that still correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's my email. Perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, regarding the device shipment. Your new Cymbal Go 5G Hotspot will ship from our warehouse within one to two business days. You can expect to receive it via courier in about three to five business days.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's great, very quick. Will it be hard to set up?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all. It's designed to be extremely user-friendly. The SIM card for your new data plan will already be installed in the device. All you'll need to do is turn it on, and it will automatically connect to the Cymbal Telecom network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, that's a relief. So I just turn it on, and then search for the Wi-Fi on my laptop?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Precisely. The Wi-Fi network name and password will be displayed on the hotspot's screen when you first turn it on. It will also be on a sticker on the back of the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: What will the network name be? Will it say Cymbal?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the default name will be something like 'Cymbal Wi-Fi' followed by a few numbers. You can easily change both the network name and password to something you prefer right from the device's touchscreen menu.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that sounds very straightforward. I think I can handle that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm confident you will. And of course, if you run into any trouble at all, our technical support team is available 24/7. The number is right in the little startup guide that comes in the box.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Wonderful. This is going to make our travels so much easier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so glad we could help get you set up for your trip. It's always exciting to help customers connect, wherever they are.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: I really appreciate how thorough you've been, Alex. You've made it very clear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's my pleasure, Ms. Wright. My goal is to make sure there are no surprises. Was there anything else at all I could assist you with today? Perhaps a question about your existing mobile plan?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that's everything for me. You've covered it all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Well, thank you again for choosing Cymbal Telecom for your new hotspot service. We truly appreciate your business.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Thank you, Alex. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You too. Enjoy your travels, and thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. Goodbye.
